name: com.gloryday.font.bitmap.bitmap-font-generator
description:
A Unity Editor tool for GloryDay projects that converts bitmap font files (.fnt) 
into TextMeshPro font assets.

Parses .fnt file format to extract glyph metrics, kerning information, and texture 
coordinates, then applies the data to an existing TMP_FontAsset, allowing bitmap 
fonts to be used seamlessly within Unity's TextMeshPro system.
